text:
The plate is a square plate of about 22 cm. It holds scrambled egg whites, or possibly a soft cheese or tofu-like food, plus about 5 pieces of cantaloupe or papaya.

Egg whites: the pile covers roughly a third of the plate, so I estimate about 120 g. At around 50 kcal per 100 g, that is about 60 kcal. If it were whole scrambled egg at about 150 kcal per 100 g it would be higher, but the pale, whitish color points to egg whites, possibly with some milk.

Orange fruit: 5 pieces at roughly 15 g each is about 75 g. At 40 kcal per 100 g, that is about 30 kcal.

Total: about 195 g and roughly 100 kcal. I'm rounding the energy up slightly to 110 kcal in case the egg is not just whites.
